_comment: Snapshot of the ESPHome web_server event format the B2500 web UI parses. See scripts/check-web-server-contract.mjs. requiredKeys is hand-maintained: the fields the web UI actually reads. alsoAccepted holds set_json_id() bodies that differ from the baseline but were read and found to emit the same id, each with the reasoning; add one with --accept, never by hand.

alsoAccepted.note: set_json_id() takes JsonObject by value and casts id_buf to const char* at the assignment (esphome/esphome f946615). Neither touches the bytes written: the id is still {domain}/{device}/{name}, or {domain}/{name} without USE_DEVICES, which parseStorageEntity() splits on '/' as before (issue #317).
